title: BT Area North of the Plate Gate
description: Description: *A BT area located to the north of the plate gate. The chiral density here is much high than in Mexico, and the area is shrouded in a red mist. There is a fear that this is somehow affecting the BTs in the area.*

title: BT Area West of the Lone Commander
description: Description: *A BT area shrouded in red mist and packed with huge rocks -- some of which are taller than a fully extended ladder. These make for a landscape that is difficult to navigate, and easy to become lost in.*

title: BT Area Northwest of the Northern Environmental Observatory
description: Description: *A BT area in the basin of the Pitchfork River, located to the northwest of the Northern Environmental Observatory. The area is often cut off when water levels rise, and the risk of being stranded means very few people choose to pass through here.*

title: BT Area South of the Metagenomicist
description: Description: *A BT area to the south of the Metagenomicist's shelter. The area features a series of gentle slopes, and is bordered to the west by a giant tar lake. Chiral density is extremely high, and BT activity has been observed.*

title: BT Area North of the F5 East Distribution Center
description: Description: *A BT area to the north of the F5 East Distribution Center. The area is known for its steep slopes, rugged terrain, and the enormous tar lake to the west. Chiral density is extremely high, and BT encounters have been reported here.*

title: BT Area North of F6
description: Description: *A BT area on the banks of the White River. It is thought to have developed after numerous people became lost in the snow, and eventually turned necro.*

title: BT Area Near the Chronobiologist: Southeast
description: Description: *A BT area that appeared as a result of a gate quake. Cargo sometimes washes up from the tar currents here, and the Phantom Smith always keeps an eye on the place. There are currently large numbers of gazers in the area, making it very dangerous to pass through.*

title: BT Area Northwest of the Pizza Chef
description: Description: *A BT area that spreads across an elevated plateau in northeastern Australia. It is filled with ruined buildings from a bygone age. The terrain is flat, making it easy to move around.*

title: BT Area Northwest of F4
description: Description: *A BT area located along the side of an old road. Timefall has destroyed most of the road, which now lies as little more than a ruin.*

title: Brigand Base North of the Government's Base
description: Description: *A newly established Brigand base to the north of the Government's Base. The eroded terrain in the area forms a series of natural barricades protecting the base. It seem the Brigands are using this location to conduct surveillance on the Government.*

title: Brigand Base Southeast of F1
description: Description: *A Brigand base located in a patch of ruins in the desert. Reports suggest that some of the hostiles based here are equipped with full-body armor. The base covers a wide area, and you can expect to encounter a significant amount of resistance.*

title: Brigand Base West of the Northern Environmental Observatory
description: Description: *A Brigand base located in a patch of ruins at the bottom of a cliff. The sheer cliff face protects one side of the base, making it easy to spot potential threats. Lots of cargo has been transported to the base, and heavily armed hostiles clad in red have also been seen, increasing the threat level.*

title: Armed Survivalist Base East of the F2 South Distribution Center
description: Description: *An Armed Survivalist base, established in what was once known as the Twin Valley Mine. The Armed Survivalists are a very dangerous group, equipped with the latest weapons, and willing to use lethal force. Some of the Survivalists spotted here are wearing heavy armor that provides excellent protection while also boosting mobility.*

title: Armed Survivalist Base Southeast of the Phantom Smith
description: Description: *An Armed Survivalist base located among the snowy mountains. It offers excellent visibility over the surrounding area, but the rocky terrain creates numerous blind spots. Heavily armored hostiles equipped with electromagnetic shields have been spotted.*

title: Armed Survivalist Base South of Heartman's Lab
description: Description: *An Armed Survivalist base established among an area of ruins in northern Australia. Guard towers have been installed around the perimeter to survey the surrounding area. The Survivalists based here are known to carry lethal weapons, terrifying the civilians that live nearby.*

title: Armed Survivalist Base Southwest of the Motherhood
description: Description: *An Armed Survivalist base surrounded by rivers. A bridge on the north side allows for vehicle access. From here the Survivalists patrol the surrounding area. Reports suggest that they attack porters who operate nearby.*

title: Miracle Spring
description: Description: *The radium in the surrounding waters makes this hot spring radioactive -- although the doses of chiral radiation are so minute as to have no harmful effects on the human body. In fact, this spring is known for its reviving properties, helping the body to flush out toxins and improving it in every way. Little wonder it's known as the "Miracle Spring."* Effect: None

title: Heartman's Spring
description: Location: Inside [Heartman's Lab](https://mapgenie.io/death-stranding-2/maps/australia?locationIds=462693) Description: *An indoor spring dug by the Hydrologist. Bathing in its warm sulfuric waters has a restorative effect, and suppresses any sense of nausea you might be feeling. It also boosts stamina.* Effect: Boosts Stamina

title: Chiral Spring
description: Description: A sulfuric hot spring that contains molten chiralium. No toxic compounds have been detected, however, and even non-DOOMS sufferers are able to enjoy bathing here. These waters have a curious effect on bathers, temporarily allowing them to carry heavier cargo loads. Effect: Increases carry weight capacity Reward: Chiral Tea

title: Healing Spring
description: Description: *The water in the hot spring is rich in calcium sulphates, making it effective at healing all kinds of injuries including cuts, bruises, and sprains. It also rapidly restores stamina and helps overcome fatigue. Animals in need of healing have been known to make use of this spring too.* Effect: Increased stamina regeneration Reward: Apples

title: Digestive Spring
description: Description: *The water in this chloride spring is so salty that its composition is very similar to sea water -- something that is caused by the tar from the tar lake, according to one theory. Bathing here stimulates the digestive system, boosting the effects of anything you eat or drink.* Effect: Improves effectiveness of consumables Reward: Tangerines

title: Metallic Spring
description: Description: *A hot spring rich in iron. The blend of chiralium and various metals gives the surface of the water a silvery gleam. Placing cargo containers in this spring will cause the metals in the water to cling to their surface, repairing any dents or cracks.* Effect: Repairs cargo containers Reward: Yuzu

title: Recharging Spring
description: Description: *The special minerals at the bottom of this spring appear to have been affected by the underground tar, and now emit an electrical current that can recharge batteries. The water also has a restorative effect on the body, but be careful not to share your bath with a battery...* Effect: Recharges batteries Reward: Eucalyptus Leaves

title: Clairovoyant Spring
description: Description: *This hot spring's vivid purple water is a byproduct of a special type of algae that only lives at high altitudes. Bathing here has the effect of sharpening one's senses, making you more aware of your surroundings and what they contain.* Effect: Highlights nearby items and points of interest Reward: Ludens Ducks

title: Tar Spring
description: Description: *The water in this slightly alkaline hot spring contains tar particles that have seeped in from the ground below. The chiral density here is very low, however, and there is no risk of chiral contamination. The combined effect of the soil and tar in this spring makes it temporarily harder for BTs to detect you.* Effect: Decreases effective BT detection Reward: Sweet Flag Leaves

title: Orange Coast
description: Description: *A rocky area bordered by the ocean to the west. Pass through during the orange glow of the sunset, and you'll see a landscape you won't soon forget.*

title: Great Falls
description: Description: *The largest waterfall on the Australian continent. Located on the upper course of the Cliffside River, it is over 80m in height. It is well known as a spot for taking photographs.*

title: North Edge Ridge
description: Description: *A ridge that stretches along the continent's northern edge. In times gone by, it offered an excellent vantage point to look over the ocean to the northeast. Nowadays, bottomless tar stretches as far as the eye can see.*

title: Brigand Base North of the Government's Base: Northeastern Area
description: Description: *A series of ditches worn away by erosion resulting in a maze-like plateau. Visibility is poor, and there are several blind spots.*

title: Brigand Base North of the Government's Base: Southeastern Area
description: Description: *Numerous rocky plateaus standing at the bottom of the Red Mist Cliffs. The top of each plateau makes for a good vantage point over the ditches below.*

title: Brigand Base Southeast of F1: Southern Area
description: Description: *An area of undulating sand dunes dotted with rocks. There are numerous patches of tall grass in which it should be possible to crouch and hide.*

title: Brigand Base Southeast of F1: Western Area
description: Description: *An area containing numerous large rocks. Several of them block the sight of the Brigand watchtower nearby.*

title: Ruins of West River Bridge
description: Description: *A large bridge across the West River. It has been damaged beyond repair. The remains on each bank do at least narrow the river, however.*

title: Rainbow Valley Entrance
description: Description: *A perilous point on the route to Rainbow Valley that passes through Rocky Town. The southern bank of the river has been badly eroded, but there is evidence that people once used this place as a crossing point.*

title: Chiral Soil
description: Description: *An area where the soil is rich in chiralium and the underground tar currents sit close to the surface. Large chiral crystals area often found here as a result, especially on the shoals and near the mine.*

title: Remains of the Scarlet River
description: Description: *The bed of a river that used to flow through Scarlet Canyon. It has now completely dried up, and doesn't run even during periods of timefall. The river basin shows no sign of brushfires.*

title: Twin Valley Tunnel
description: Description: *A tunnel once used to transport goods to and from the Twin Valley Mine. It's in good condition, and large enough to accommodate vehicles. Unfortunately, it also used by the Armed Survivalists to access their base -- proceed with caution.*

title: Red Mist Cliffs: Western Area
description: Description: *Separating the Government's Base from the Lone Commander's shelter, these cliffs are frequently seen shrouded in a crimson fog. Some slopes area not as steep as they look, and there area routes that can be navigated with relative ease.*

title: Armed Survivalist Base East of the F2 South Distribution Center: Northeastern Area
description: Description: *An area located to the northeast of what was once known as the Twin Valley Mine. While there are many steep slopes and large rock formations in the vicinity, this area is comparatively obstacle free, and can be traversed with relative ease.*

title: Remains of Twin Valley River
description: Description: *The remains of a river that used to flow through Twin Valley. It has now completely dried up, though the height of its banks suggest the water was once deep enough to drown in.*

title: Red River
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *A river that flows to the southwest of the Government's Base. Its basin is often filled with a red mist. Erosion of the riverbank suggests the surrounding area is prone to frequent flooding. When the water level rises, you will need to head upstream to find a safe place to cross.*

title: Red Mist Cliffs: Southern Area
description: Warning Type: Cliff Description: *Extending to the south of the Lone Commander's shelter, these cliffs are frequently engulfed in a red mist. Visibility is poor and accidents are common. Their southern side is tall and steep.*

title: Red Mist Cliffs: Northwestern Area
description: Warning Type: Cliff Description: *Stretching northwest of the Lone Commander's shelter, these cliffs are drenched in a red fog. Many slips and falls have been reported, as travelers claim the cliffs suddenly appear through the mist before their eyes.*

title: Desert River
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *??*

title: Brigand Base Southeast of F1: Southwestern Area
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *A watchtower allowing for surveillance of the surrounding region. Clusters of large rocks can be found to the west.*

title: West River
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *A river that flows past West Fort Knot (F1), comprising a main stream and multiple tributaries. The main stream is wider than the length of two ladders joined together, and very deep. Many people find themselves stranded and unable to cross when its water levels rise.*

title: West River/Upstream
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *This upstream stretch of the river that flows through Rainbow Valley is relatively narrow. Despite this, there have been reports of inattentive porters getting in trouble when crossing at night.*

title: Windy Plateau
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *An elevated plateau known for its strong winds, located to the north of the giant tar lake. Large parts of the plateau are covered in rocks, and there have been sightings of wild animals and chiral creatures in the area.*

title: Causeway Cay
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *A shallow beach where scattered sandbars for a path. Porters have reported being attacked by groups of chiral creatures in this area.*

title: Northwest Coast
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *A section of Australia's northwestern coastline. It is often affected by the tar currents that flow beneath it, and earthquakes are a common occurrence. There are a number of rivers in the northern part of this area. The monorail track can be restored using the terminals nearby.*

title: Twin Creeks
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *Two small rivers that flow from the base of a steep cliff. Many people used to run into trouble here when the water levels rose, so a monorail line was built to span both rivers. Timefall has taken a terrible toll on the track, however, and the monorail is not currently operational.*

title: Scarlet Canyon
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *An impressive canyon named for its red soil and rocks. Flanked by high, sheer cliffs, it is home to eucalypts and many other plant species. The land is also prone to dryness, so when a forest fire breaks out, it spreads quickly and dangerously.*

title: Firehawk's Valley
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *A valley littered with blackened and charred objects. It got its name from the hawks that would use fire to drive their prey here before moving in for the kill. There aren't many alternative routes through the area, but do be careful if the flames force you down into the valley.*

title: Rampart Rocks
description: Warning Type: Cliff Description: *A soaring group of rocks that resemble a castle wall. Climbing to the top provides an excellent vantage point over the ruins below. It is very treacherous underfoot, however, and many people have slipped and fallen here.*

title: Cape Fort River
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *A river that flows past the F2 South Distribution Center. It once flowed into Cape Fort Knot (F2), but the city has since been submerged in the tar. The lower course of the river, marked by the merging of two streams, is very wide. But the upper course is relatively easy to cross, even when the water levels are high.*

title: Northern Desert
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *The largest desert in Australia, located in the northeastern part of the continent. Lying next to the ocean, its sands are often whipped up into storms by the powerful sea breeze. Visibility is often poor as a result, and many people find themselves lost, unable to work out which direction they're traveling in. A BT area that contains large quantities of chiral crystals is known to lie somewhere among the sands.*

title: Cliffside River: Tributary
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *A tributary of the upper course of the Cliffside River. The Cliffside River is famous for being difficult to cross, but gets narrower upstream beyond this point. In some places, it is even possible to jump across.*

title: Pitchfork River
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *A river that is shaped like a pitchfork and flows through Australia's northwestern plains. It has a number of tributaries that are usually dried up. A BT area stretches across the river basin, where timefall is a frequent occurrence. When the water levels rise, the tributaries fill up, changing the river's overall shape.*

title: Cliffside River
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *A river that runs along the bottom of a steep cliff in the northwestern part of the continent. Its upper course flows over a sheer drop, forming a waterfall. A number of tributaries join the main flow midway along, causing the river to widen significantly. It is therefore famous for being difficult to cross.*

title: Giant Tar Lake
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *Australia's largest tar lake, formed by a number of voidouts. The tar is said to be bottomless, and emerging alive after being submerged is easier said than done. Cargo washes up on the shores of the lake from time to time.*

title: Great Crater Cliffs: Southern Area
description: Warning Type: Cliff Description: *A wall of cliffs encircling a giant tar lake. Formed by a series of voidouts, the sheer rock faces are extremely treacherous to traverse. The top of the cliffs offers a good view of the ghost mech factory.*

title: White River
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *A river that flows to the west of South Fort Knot (F6). It is supplied by water that runs down from the snowy mountains. A BT area covers the basin of the river. The fast-flowing water and snow-covered ground makes this terrain difficult to traverse.*

title: Icy Mountain Trail
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *A path once used to scale the peaks of the snowy mountains. Very little of the path now remains. It is very steep in places, and it is clear that rockfalls often take place here.*

title: Warrigal Cliff
description: Warning Type: Cliff Description: *A cliff located in the southern part of Australia's Central Highlands. There are signs that a gate quake has destroyed part of the cliff face, where many climbers who follow the ridge then find themselves at an impasse -- standing atop a jagged rock, like a wild wolf of old.*

title: Central Highlands: Eastern Area
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *The eastern part of the mountain range that rises in the center of the Australian continent. Its peaks are clustered tightly together in a severe string of ups and downs. Deep snow and low temperatures will drain your stamina, making these inclines a daunting prospect. Many mountaineers misjudge their route, and suffer painful falls.*

title: North Edge River
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *A river that flows through northern Australia, originating in the mining regions to the south. The river is known for being narrow but deep.*

title: North Edge Ridge: Southeastern Area
description: Warning Type: Cliff Description: *The southeastern portion of a ridge that stretches along the continent's northern edge. There are a number of steep cliffs here, and evidence that many aspiring mountaineers have tried and failed to scale them.*

title: North Edge Ridge: Southern Area
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *The southern portion of a ridge that stretches along the continent's northern edge. Timefall and gate quakes have destabilized the terrain, and it is clear that numerous rockfalls have taken place.*

title: Bushfire Zone
description: Warning Type: Fire Description: *Many flammable trees grow in this area, and bushfires area a regular occurrence. These are triggered by simple natural causes: high temperatures and extreme drought.*

title: Pillar Rocks: Southern Area
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *An area filled with sandstone formations that have eroded into strange shapes. Wild animals have been spotted in the southern part of this area. Porters have also reported being attacked by chiral creatures, so be careful.*

title: Pillar Rocks
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *An area filled with sandstone formations that have eroded into strange shapes. Some of them look like settlements, and numerous porters appear to have been lured into the rocks only to be attacked by chiral creatures.*

title: East River
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *A wide river that flows through the area of savannah in eastern Australia. There are a number of places where the water is usually shallow enough to cross, but a bridge will be your only option should the water levels begin to rise.*

title: Northern Desert: Southern Area
description: Warning Type: Standard Description: *Australia's largest desert extends across the northeast of the continent. This area is located in the southern part of that desert. Porters have reported hearing strange explosions when traveling nearby.*

title: South Edge River
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *A wide river that flows to the east of Terminal Fort Knot (F8). It can only be crossed via a bridge when the water levels rise, but during calmer times, when the water is shallow, it is possible to wade across.*

title: Pincer Rivers
description: Warning Type: Deep River Description: *Rivers that flow south of East Fort Knot (F4) toward the east of the continent. They are narrow and relatively easy too cross. Their shape resembles the pincers of a crab, hence their name. Wild animals are often spotted near these rivers.*

title: BT Area South of C1
description: Description: *A BT area that spreads out to the south of the Ciudad Nudo del Norte (C1). The tar in this area has been used to dispose of corpses from C1 for a long time. As a result, chiral density has increased and BTs have started appearing in the vicinity.*

title: BT Area North of the Research Lab
description: Description: *High chiral density has been detected in this BT area. According to reports, abandoned cargo can be found around the ruined church at its center.*

title: Bandit Base Near North of the C1 South Distribution Center
description: Description: *A group of ruined buildings that now house a Bandit base. The dilapidated structures and dense vegetation make it difficult to see and anticipate enemy attacks. Great care must be taken when traversing this area.*

title: Bandit Base Northwest of C1
description: Description: *A Bandit base northwest of Ciudad Nudo del Norte (C1). Multiple reports have noted porters en route to and from C1 being attacked and robbed by Bandits. Freight vehicles have also been seen here.*

title: Bandit Base at the Old Border
description: Description: *A base established in a former border checkpoint that now belongs to an armed group known as the Bandits. They will attack any porter that passes through the area, with many already suffering at their hands.*

description: Description: *A large bridge that spans the old border. It was the only means of crossing the Frontier River without wading through the water. Bandits have been known to attack travelers along the bridge, which now sits littered with abandoned cars.*

title: Great Canyon Creek
description: Description: *A river known for the cacti that grow along its banks. It has been known to swell to the width of one or two ladders in times of heavy timefall upstream.*

title: Frontier River
description: Description: *Joining the sea at the Gulf of Mexico, this river once formed part of the US-Mexico border. Its tributaries upstream area usually dried up, but the water level has been known to rise rapidly during periods of heavy timefall.*

title: Spider Hill
description: Description: *A steep hill with dense vegetation located between Villa Libre and the C1 South Distribution Center. The hill takes its name from the mysterious spider-like creatures that many people have reported seeing in the area.*

title: Central River
description: Description: *A river that flows through central Mexico. It passes through Bandit territory, and many porters have reported being attacked while trying to cross.*

title: Shoeslasher Slope
description: Warning Type: Cliff Description: *A steep slope that has tested even the most capable of porters. Legend has it that no pair of boots are sturdy enough to survive the climb. True or not, you'd do well to remember such warnings if you try to scramble up...*
